extDesc: Batch extract and clean URLs from text. Simple, efficient, ad-free.

popup.title: LinkFlow
popup.textareaPlaceholder: Paste text containing multiple links here...
popup.emptyNoInput: Please enter or paste text to extract links

settings.intro: Customize the JavaScript regex used to identify links. Characters in the language cleanup list are removed before extraction.
settings.defaultRuleDesc: Matches domains with or without http/https, and extracts port, path, query parameters, and hash fragments. The global flag g is auto-enabled.
settings.patternHelp: Enter the regex body without surrounding slashes. Example: https?:\/\/example\.com\/\S+
settings.flagsHelp: g (global) is auto-enabled; common flags: i case-insensitive, m multiline, s dotAll, u Unicode.
settings.saveSuccess: All settings saved. Newly opened LinkFlow popups will use the updated rules.
settings.saveError: Invalid regex, please check and try again.
settings.footnote: After saving, newly opened LinkFlow popups will immediately use this rule. The regex runs locally in the browser and no input text is uploaded.
settings.quickLangDesc: Click a button to insert the corresponding Unicode character range at the cursor position for extending regex matching.
settings.languageIntro: Choose the language used in the settings page and popup.
settings.noiseRulesDesc: Enabled character ranges are removed before extraction. Add or remove ranges as needed. Rules match characters only, so URL separators remain intact.
settings.bracketCleanupDesc: Selected pairs and their contents are removed before extraction. Supports brackets, angle brackets, book-title marks, braces, and single or double quotes.
settings.bracketOptionsLabel: Choose brackets and their contents to remove
settings.rangeHint: Range example: \u3040-\u30ff (Hiragana and Katakana). Enter Unicode characters or ranges, not regex brackets.
settings.invalidLanguageRule: Enter a name and a valid Unicode character range for every row.
settings.duplicateLanguageRule: This language is already added. Remove it before adding it again.
settings.aboutIntro: A lightweight, privacy-first local link cleaner.
settings.aboutDescription: Extract, deduplicate, and clean URLs from mixed text, with custom regex and multilingual character cleanup.
settings.aboutLocal: All processing runs locally in your browser; no text is uploaded.
settings.aboutRegex: Matching rules and language character ranges can be customized.
